_comment: costs[i] is the price to build (i=0) or upgrade to level i+1. Per-level values are arrays indexed by level-1. Services are implemented per building id in scripts/core/company.gd. staff_seats[level-1]: townsfolk seats (default config staff_seats). produce: materials made each week by level, before staff (Lumber Yard, Mine, Trapping Post).

saloon.name: Saloon
saloon.desc: Whiskey, cards and a piano nobody's tuned since '49. Heroes shed Fatigue here, and sit out the next expedition.

chatter.name: Chatter
chatter.desc: More talk at the bar: more side quests to choose from each week.

tips.name: Loose Lips
tips.desc: Better leads: side quests with richer rewards, and more bosses and rare trinkets.

strangers_table.name: Stranger's Table
strangers_table.desc: A quiet table in the back where drifters leave word. The Lone Wanderer's challenges turn up here.

side_effects.text: %s loses their shirt at faro. (-120 chips)

chapel.name: Chapel
chapel.desc: A whitewashed church with a crooked steeple. A quieter kind of rest.

side_effects.text: %s finds something uplifting in the hymns.

doctor.name: Doctor's Office
doctor.desc: Carbolic, laudanum and a bone saw. Treats bad habits and broken spirits.

smithy.name: Smithy
smithy.desc: The ring of hammer on anvil. Upgrades weapons and armor.

drill_hall.name: Drill Hall
drill_hall.desc: An old army barracks where veterans pass on hard-won tricks. Teaches new combat moves and trains known ones.

general_store.name: General Store
general_store.desc: Flour, powder, rope and nails. Supplies expeditions and sells the odd trinket.

hiring_board.name: Hiring Board
hiring_board.desc: A plank wall papered with notices. New hands arrive every week.

activities.name: Sit a Spell on the Porch
activities.desc: A rocking chair, a long look at the horizon, nobody asking anything. Free, one seat.

notices.name: More Notices
notices.desc: More recruits answer the board each week.

reputation.name: Word of Mouth
reputation.desc: Better recruits: a chance of higher levels, and better quirks.

bunks.name: Bunkhouse
bunks.desc: Bunks out back: room for more heroes in the company.

stage_line.name: Stage Line
stage_line.desc: A stable, a stagecoach and a driver who's seen it all. Sends heroes between settlements: one week per stop.

boot_hill.name: Boot Hill
boot_hill.desc: Wooden crosses on a windy rise. The company remembers its dead. Visiting heroes shed Fatigue.

lumber_yard.name: Lumber Yard
lumber_yard.desc: A sawpit, a log pile and a mule to drag them. Cuts Timber every week; Loggers cut more.

mine.name: Iron Mine
mine.desc: A timbered adit into the hill behind town. Digs Iron every week; Muckers dig more.

trapping_post.name: Trapping Post
trapping_post.desc: Stretching frames and a smokehouse by the creek. Brings in Hides every week; Trappers bring more.
